title: Changelog
description: The record the platform generates when preparing a push and the bridge agents read after a pull to understand what landed and update the backlog (ADR-014; one task, one branch, one worktree, one changelog).

taskRefs.description: The tasks this changelog belongs to. That each id resolves to a task that exists is a cross-artifact check the core performs, not something this schema can see.

branch.description: The branch this changelog was generated for. One task, one branch, one worktree, one changelog.

changes.description: What moved in the working tree, one entry per path.

impacts.description: Documents and definitions this change affects — what an agent reads after a pull to catch up beyond the diff itself.

change.description: One changed path. A rename that does not say where it came from cannot be followed, so previousPath is required whenever kind is renamed.

previousPath.description: The path this file was renamed from. Required when kind is renamed.

allOf.title: A renamed file names the path it came from
